papers.title: Using Bayesian Optimization to Guide Probing of a Flexible Environment for Simultaneous Registration and Stiffness Mapping
papers.abstract: One of the goals of computer-aided surgery is to match intraoperative data to preoperative images of the anatomy and add complementary information that can facilitate the task of surgical navigation. In this context, mechanical palpation can reveal critical anatomical features such as arteries and cancerous lumps which are stiffer that the surrounding tissue. This work uses position and force measurements obtained during mechanical palpation for registration and stiffness mapping. Prior approaches, including our own, exhaustively palpated the entire organ to achieve this goal. To overcome the costly palpation of the entire organ, a Bayesian optimization framework is introduced to guide the end effector to palpate stiff regions while simultaneously updating the registration of the end effector to an a priori geometric model of the organ, hence enabling the fusion of ntraoperative data into the a priori model obtained through imaging. This new framework uses Gaussian processes to model the stiffness distribution and Bayesian optimization to direct where to sample next for maximum information gain. The proposed method was evaluated with experimental data obtained using a Cartesian robot interacting with a silicone organ model and an ex vivo porcine liver.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法使用了贝叶斯优化和高斯过程代理模型，对于高效采样和不确定性量化具有参考价值，但未涉及有限元分析或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve FEA simulations, implant design optimization, or handling of constraints typical in biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少术中机械触诊的全面采样成本，同时实现配准和刚度映射。
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程建模刚度分布，贝叶斯优化引导探针在信息增益最大处采样。
summary_zh.result: 方法在硅胶器官模型和离体猪肝上成功指导探针触及硬区域并同步更新配准。
summary_zh.validation: 通过硅胶模型和离体猪肝实验验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the cost of exhaustive palpation during surgical navigation by efficiently probing stiff regions while simultaneously performing registration.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework with Gaussian processes models the stiffness distribution and directs the end-effector to sample at locations of maximum information gain.
summary_en.result: The method effectively guides probing to stiff regions and updates registration, validated on a silicone organ phantom and ex vivo porcine liver.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation using a Cartesian robot on a silicone model and ex vivo porcine liver.

papers.title: Cementless total hip arthroplasty for patients previously treated with femoral osteotomy for hip dysplasia: the incidence of periprosthetic fracture

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是临床回顾性研究，关注股骨截骨术后全髋关节置换的假体周围骨折发生率，未涉及任何生物力学或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper reports clinical outcomes (periprosthetic fracture incidence) and does not quantify femoral stress shielding, micromotion, or include any finite element modeling or mechanical testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估股骨截骨术后行非骨水泥全髋置换的假体周围骨折风险
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析既往股骨截骨患者的THA临床资料
summary_zh.result: 假体周围骨折发生率较高，需注意手术技术和患者选择
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者数据统计

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the risk of periprosthetic fracture in patients undergoing cementless THA after prior femoral osteotomy.
summary_en.method: Retrospective clinical review of THA outcomes in patients with previous femoral osteotomy.
summary_en.result: A relatively high incidence of periprosthetic fractures was observed, emphasizing careful surgical technique and patient selection.
summary_en.validation: Validation based on clinical patient data and statistical analysis.
